verdict.rationale: A community user praises being able to track how many users a particular bug affects, and BugSnag's docs say grouping is meant to show which issues have the biggest impact on users. Session-based impact is documented only as project-level stability (the proportion of error-free sessions), not as a per-issue count. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of per-issue affected-user counts, per-issue affected-session counts, sorting or prioritizing issues by users or sessions instead of event counts, and recent hands-on corroboration.
